name: switch_daemon_disabled
reason: no daemon was started and no lock file appeared, while the hooks still answered and spooled
detail: all six hooks exit 0 with empty or parseable JSON with no additionalContext; /tmp/qompack-release-1206493361/project/.qompack/run/daemon.lock never appeared; the spool holds 6 file(s) [client-97337.ndjson client-97342.ndjson client-97353.ndjson client-97359.ndjson client-97364.ndjson client-97375.ndjson], which is what distinguishes a disabled daemon from a disabled plugin. `config print --json` reports runtime.daemon.enabled=false (status --json is not used: this switch starts no daemon). Not duplicated here: test/e2e's v5_x15 daemon-off project covers the end-to-end path
